label: Payroc Cloud card-present
openQuestions: CP-02: UAT decline trigger amounts/cards not documented in skill
CP-05: How to simulate device offline/timeout in UAT (simulator?) not documented
CP-07: Source of a settled UAT payment for referenced refund not documented
CP-12: UAT surcharge setup not documented
CP-13: closed-loop test cards not documented
Cloud error shape is assumed to match the standard envelope and is unverified on Cloud (per skill)
Prefix CP assumed for Cloud (authoring guide lists no dedicated Cloud prefix)

scenarios.title: Cloud sale: submit, poll, follow link, retrieve payment
scenarios.objective: Verify the full async instruction flow ends in a retrieved payment, not just a 202.
steps: POST a payment instruction to the device serialNumber with a fresh Idempotency-Key and order.orderId = Test Tag.
Persist paymentInstructionId from the 202.
GET /v1/payment-instructions/{id} and await the response (gateway holds ~60s); re-issue only while status is inProgress.
On completed, follow link.href (do not build the URL from the instruction id) to GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}.
Branch on transactionResult/payment status using the full approval set (ready and complete are both approvals).
scenarios.expected: Submit returns 202 with status inProgress and an instruction id. Poll reaches completed with link.href pointing at a paymentId distinct from the instruction id. Retrieved payment shows an approved outcome (responseCode A).
scenarios.testData: Use a UAT device serialNumber and processingTerminalId provisioned by Payroc, or the Payroc Cloud Simulator (cloud.uat.payroc.com). Amounts are integer cents.
scenarios.pitfalls: Treating 202 or a 200 poll as approval; synthesising /payments/{instructionId}; hand-rolled tight poll loops.

scenarios.title: Sale outcome read from payment, not instruction (decline path)
scenarios.objective: Verify the partner reads the bank outcome from the retrieved payment and handles a declined result.
steps: Submit a sale instruction using the documented UAT decline trigger.
Poll to completed (or failure) and follow the link.
Show the POS surfacing the declined result from the retrieved payment.
scenarios.expected: Instruction completes; retrieved payment shows a declined status/responseCode D. POS does not treat the instruction completing as an approval.
scenarios.testData: Use the UAT trigger documented at docs.payroc.com (confirm with Payroc)

scenarios.title: Cancel an in-progress instruction
scenarios.objective: Verify the partner can cancel an instruction while the device is still waiting.
steps: Submit a sale instruction; do not complete it on the device.
DELETE /v1/payment-instructions/{id} while status is inProgress.
GET the instruction and confirm status canceled.
scenarios.expected: DELETE returns 204; subsequent GET shows status canceled and no payment is created.

scenarios.title: Cancel after completion is rejected
scenarios.objective: Verify the partner checks status before cancelling and handles 409.
steps: Complete a sale instruction.
Attempt DELETE on the completed instruction.
Show the POS handling the 409 by re-reading status.
scenarios.expected: DELETE returns 409; POS surfaces current status rather than retrying blindly.

scenarios.title: Offline/timeout retry with the same Idempotency-Key
scenarios.objective: Verify a retried submission does not create a second device instruction.
steps: Submit a sale instruction and simulate a client timeout before the response is read.
Resend the byte-for-byte identical body with the same Idempotency-Key.
Confirm only one instruction/payment results.
scenarios.expected: Retry returns the original instruction result; only one paymentInstructionId and at most one payment exist for the order.
scenarios.pitfalls: Generating a new key on retry causes a duplicate charge attempt.

scenarios.title: Idempotency key reused with a changed body
scenarios.objective: Verify the partner handles 409 when a key is reused with a different body.
steps: Submit an instruction.
Resubmit with the same Idempotency-Key but a different amount.
scenarios.expected: Gateway returns 409; partner generates a fresh key only for the genuinely new submission.

scenarios.title: Referenced refund against a settled payment
scenarios.objective: Verify a referenced refund uses the standard payments API with the original paymentId.
steps: Locate the original payment via GET /v1/payments/{paymentId} or GET /v1/payments search.
Check supportedOperations includes refund.
POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refunds with amount and currency and a new Idempotency-Key.
scenarios.expected: 201 with a refund resource; amount does not exceed original. Note: against an open-batch payment the platform auto-reverses instead.
scenarios.testData: Requires a settled payment (closed batch). Confirm with Payroc how to obtain a settled UAT payment.
scenarios.pitfalls: Expecting a refund record when the payment is still in an open batch.

scenarios.title: Unreferenced refund via device instruction
scenarios.objective: Verify an unreferenced refund runs as a refund instruction with order.description.
steps: POST /v1/devices/{serialNumber}/refund-instructions with order.description set.
Poll, follow the link, and GET /v1/refunds/{refundId}.
scenarios.expected: 202 then completed; refund retrieved with responseCode A.

scenarios.title: Reverse a payment in an open batch
scenarios.objective: Verify reversal of an unsettled payment uses the reverse endpoint.
steps: Complete a sale instruction (batch still open).
POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/reverse with a new Idempotency-Key (omit amount for full).
scenarios.expected: 200; payment reflects reversal; no funds moved.

scenarios.title: Signature capture
scenarios.objective: Verify standalone signature instruction flow and decoding.
steps: POST /v1/devices/{serialNumber}/signature-instructions with processingTerminalId.
Poll, follow the signature link, GET /v1/signatures/{signatureId}.
Decode the Base64 signature using contentType.
scenarios.expected: Completed instruction; signature retrieved with contentType (e.g. image/png) and decodes to an image.

scenarios.title: Tip prompted on device
scenarios.objective: Verify tip is sent in order.breakdown and reflected on the payment.
steps: Submit a sale with breakdown.subtotal and tip {type, mode: prompted}.
Complete on device and retrieve the payment.
scenarios.expected: Payment amount equals subtotal + tip; tip reported on the retrieved payment.
scenarios.pitfalls: Total amount must reconcile with breakdown.

scenarios.title: Surcharge on a card-present sale
scenarios.objective: Verify surcharge is expressed in order.breakdown.surcharge and bypass is honoured.
steps: Submit a sale with breakdown.surcharge (percentage or amount).
Optionally submit with surcharge.bypass true and compare.
scenarios.expected: Retrieved payment reflects surcharge per request; bypass removes it.
scenarios.testData: Requires a processing account boarded with a surcharge-capable pricing program. Confirm UAT setup with Payroc.

scenarios.title: Closed-loop read retrieval
scenarios.objective: Verify closed-loop read payload is retrieved and treated as unstructured.
steps: Issue an instruction configured with closedLoopOptions.
Retrieve GET /v1/closed-loop-reads/{closedLoopReadId}.
scenarios.expected: 200; data object returned; partner does not assume a fixed schema.
scenarios.testData: Closed-loop card/test data not documented; confirm with Payroc.

scenarios.title: Device lookup
scenarios.objective: Verify the partner resolves a device serialNumber via GET /devices.
steps: GET /v1/devices (optionally active=true) and select the target serialNumber.

scenarios.title: Pre-authorization (autoCapture false)
scenarios.objective: Verify pre-auth is requested deliberately with autoCapture false.
steps: Submit a payment instruction with autoCapture false.
Retrieve payment and confirm type preAuthorization.
